{{Quote|Chewbacca and Salporin have been friends since childhood, and have not seen each other in many years. Their greeting must not be interrupted.|[[Ralrracheen]]|<ref name="HttE" />}}
'''Salporin''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior, the mate of [[Gorrlyn]] and close friend of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], he and Chewbacca undertook many childhood adventures together, becoming close friends. Soon after Chewbacca departed his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Salporin's skills with the [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]] took him to the Wookiee city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], where he served as a hunter and a craftsman. He met his future wife Gorrlyn in Kachirho; they later married and were planning to begin a family together when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] came to Kashyyyk. Their plans were shattered, though they volunteered to protect their homeworld from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]], helping to defeat the Separatist droid army on the planet's expansive beaches. In the aftermath of the victory, however, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were all but [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|wiped out]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed. One of the Empire's first acts was to enslave the Wookiee species; Salporin was among them, and was an Imperial captive for many years.

Eventually, Salporin was rescued by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and helped liberate Kashyyyk from Imperial rule. When Kashyyyk was free, he relocated to the capitol city of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] and returned to life as a citizen. [[9 ABY/Legends|Several years later]], he agreed to house and help protect a friend of Chewbacca's, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], from Imperial assassination attempts during her stay on Kashyyyk. He was ultimately killed during a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Thrawn campaign)|raid]] by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and a Wookiee memorial was held in his honor.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Salporin, whose name meant "storm sage" in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]],<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and a member of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. From a young age, he displayed considerable skills with a weapon, and became a master at utilizing the traditional weapon of the Wookiees, the curved [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]].<ref name="DB" /> He was also adept at utilizing two blades simultaneously, making him a formidable warrior.<ref name="HttES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> From an early age, Salporin was very close to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], another Wookiee close to him in years. He and Chewbacca became best friends, and went on many adventures together on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="DB" />

In advance of their coming-of-age [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|Hrrtayyk ceremony]], the two traveled to the dreaded [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadow Forest]] on Kashyyyk, armed with only a ryyk blade that Salporin had stolen from his elder brother. The Shadow Forest was out of bounds for two so young, though Salporin and his companion managed to keep their expedition a secret from their elders. The reasoning behind the trip was to prepare them for what was unknown to them shortly before becoming full-fledged adults, though in truth they simply frightened themselves. When they eventually reached the darkness of the Shadow Forest, their previous courage and bravado quickly faded, and they became skittish and scared. It took but a simple [[Rkkrrkkrl|trap-spinner]] to frighten them enough to flee; they ran back to their homes, the memories of what they had experienced haunting them. The horrors of the Shadow Forest plagued them until they did finally become adults.<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

===Coming-of-age===
{{Quote|With his late friend Salporin, Chewbacca left the nursery ring to venture down along the Rryatt Trail to the Well of the Dead, in the heart of the Shadow Forest. Armed only with a ryyyk blade, he braved mock shyrr, jaddyyk moss, needlebug, trap-spinnerr, and shadow-keeperr to harvest strands from the heart of the flesh-eating syren, thus earning the right to wearr a baldric, carry a weapon, and confirm the name he chose to be known by.|translated=1|Ralrracheen|<ref name="HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
Some time later, the two friends decided to journey to the Shadow Forest once again; they had matured both physically and mentally, and were far more prepared. Each armed with a ryyk blade, the two Wookiees used the [[Rryatt Trail]] to reach the [[Well of the Dead]], located in the very heart of the Shadow Forest. Here, they fought off many of Kashyyyk's most vicious predators, including the [[mock shyr]], [[jaddyyk moss]], [[Needlebug/Legends|needlebugs]], [[Rkkrrkkrl|trap-spinners]] and the [[Kkekkrrg rro|shadow-keeper]]. They managed to bring strands taken from the carnivorous [[Syren plant/Legends|syren plant]] back home, earning themselves the formal right to be armed, to wear a baldric and to confirm the names they had selected for themselves. The pair's exploits continued, and they built a reputation as two of the foremost Wookiee warriors of their generation.<ref name="HT" />

Salporin's martial abilities eventually allowed for him to move away from his homeland. The Wookiee warrior took up residence in the coastal city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]], while Chewbacca left Kashyyyk to venture offworld. Although he missed his childhood friend dearly, Salporin did not accompany Chewbacca, preferring to stay behind and work as both a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] and a craftsman. During his time of Kachirho, he met and subsequently fell in love with a Wookiee female named [[Gorrlyn]]. The two had great plans for the future, and wished to begin a family together.<ref name="DB" />

===Clone Wars and captivity===
[[File:Salporin.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Salporin, Wookiee warrior]]
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out across the galaxy, Salporin's plans of settling down with Gorrlyn were shattered. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], near the close of the war, he and his mate were among the hundreds of Wookiees who volunteered to help defend Kachirho from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which was attacking Kashyyyk in order to get a hold of secret Wookiee hyperspace routes.<ref name="DB" /> Aided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]],<ref name="HE">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref> and under the command of [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]], Salporin and his fellow Wookiees set up a defensive perimeter on one of the archipelago's large beaches. Salporin participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], assisting the Wookiees in repelling the droid forces of the CIS.<ref name="DB" />

Although they had been victorious, the war marked a beginning of a time of hardship for the Wookiee people. The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], had initiated [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic's clone troopers]] to fire on their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|generals]]. Master Yoda managed to survive, and with the aid of Wookiees was transported offworld,<ref name="ROTS" /> while Quinlan Vos managed to escape by himself. Luminara Unduli, however, was gunned down on the beach,<ref name="HE" /> and few Jedi across the galaxy survived. The first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], headed by Palpatine, was formed, and one of the first acts of the new Empire was to seize control of Kashyyyk. Thousands of Wookiees were [[Slavery/Legends|taken captive]], among them Salporin.<ref name="DB" /> When Chewbacca visited his homeworld in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Salporin was still in captivity, to Chewbacca's immense sadness.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>

After many years in captivity, Salporin was presented with an opportunity to escape. He discovered that a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] commandos had secretly set up camp on the lower levels of the Kashyyyk jungle, unbeknownst to the Empire. Salporin escaped from the Imperial slavers, literally breaking his chains and making contact with the Alliance members. Salporin's knowledge of the Kashyyyk forest, as well as of the Imperial slave camps, proved useful to the Rebels, and he agreed to help them fight off the Empire. Through his efforts, as well as those of other Wookiees put in similar situations, the Alliance was able to liberate Kashyyyk from Imperial control. After his role in the war was completed, Salporin returned to the life of a citizen.<ref name="HttES" /><ref name="G">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

===Later life===
[[File:SalporinRalrraLeia.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Salporin and Ralrracheen greet Leia Organa.]]
Salporin did not return to Kachirho, instead setting up a home in the city of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. He lived a simple life for many years, though when his old friend Chewbacca asked for his help in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], he gladly agreed. Chewbacca's longtime friend and co-pilot, Han Solo, had married [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and she was expecting twins. Organa Solo was heavily involved in the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and had been targeted for kidnapping by vicious [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] warriors sent by the remnants of the Empire. Seeking a safe haven during [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic, Organa Solo accompanied Chewbacca to Kashyyyk on the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']], where they were met by Salporin and another Wookiee named [[Ralrracheen]]. Salporin had arranged for Chewbacca and Organa Solo to stay in his house, where they would be able to hide from Thrawn's assassins.<ref name="HttE" />

Salporin greeted Chewbacca warmly, though he made no attempt to communicate with Organa Solo. After their reunion, Salporin and Chewbacca escorted Organa Solo to Salporin's home. Before they had even reached the house, Organa Solo caught sight of one of the Noghri aliens who had attacked her previously, causing quite a commotion among the Wookiees nearby. Salporin and Ralrracheen searched the building where Organa Solo thought she had spotted the creature, though they could find no sign of it. Although Ralrracheen expressed his interest in continuing the search for the kidnapper on the lower levels of the city, Chewbacca overrode him; Organa Solo's safety was the most important matter at hand.<ref name="HttE" />

While Salporin and Ralrracheen, among others, kept watch over Organa Solo, the Wookiees of Rwookrrorro continued the search for the elusive alien the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] had seen, with little result. After several days the urgency of the search wore down, and some of the Wookiees became skeptical that the being actually existed. Eventually, only a handful of Wookiees continued the search, while Salporin, Chewbacca and Ralrracheen were left with the task of protecting Organa Solo alone. They knew that this was the Empire's plan, to patiently wait for the Wookiees' vigilance to whittle away; it was not possible for them to keep acting against an enemy they could not see. Although the others gave up, Salporin and his friends stayed by Organa Solo's side.<ref name="HttE" />

===Death===
{{Quote|Where's Salporin?''"<br />&laquo;''He did not survive the attack.''&raquo;|Leia Organa Solo learns of Salporin's fate from Ralrracheen|<ref name="HttE" />|trans=1}}
Almost a week after Leia Organa Solo first arrived on Kashyyyk, [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Thrawn campaign)|the Noghri struck]]. They first set fire to a nearby house as a diversion and then attacked the Wookiee's house stealthily. Using stunners, which were far less noisy than conventional blasters, three Noghri attacked Salporin and the others stationed outside his home, while a fourth attempted to kidnap Organa Solo. The stun weapons they were using, however, proved too weak to seriously harm a Wookiee, and Ralrracheen and Chewbacca suffered only superficial injuries. Salporin, however, was killed by the Noghri.<ref name="HttE" />

Though they were deeply saddened, Chewbacca and Ralrracheen did not mourn their fallen comrade immediately; they still had to get Organa Solo to safety. They managed to fight off the other Noghri, before Organa Solo made an alliance with the aliens' leader. Now that they were safe from Thrawn's assassins, the Wookiees began mourning Salporin's death. The whole village attended a memorial service in his honor, which lasted for several hours.<ref name="HttE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your husband, Salporin, gave his life protecting Leia from Noghri assassins.|Han Solo, to Salporin's widow, Gorrlyn|<ref name="HT" />}}
Salporin was a brave being, and ventured into the darkness of the Kashyyyk jungle where many others would not have.<ref name="HT" /><ref name="TT" /> In his youth, he was full of courage and bravado, and along with Chewbacca sought to impress his elders. Initially, this bravery faded in the face of adversity,<ref name="TT" /> though after he had matured, Salporin was capable of facing many of Kashyyyk's nightmarish creatures without fear.<ref name="HT" /> He was also willing to play his part in war, and volunteered on more than one occasion to fight on behalf of his homeworld. During the Clone Wars, he aided in the defense of Kashyyyk,<ref name="DB" /> and later, after being freed by the Rebels, stayed with them to help his fellow Wookiees rather than return to the luxury of his home.<ref name="HttES" /> Later, he volunteered to help someone he had never met before&mdash;Princess Leia Organa Solo&mdash;out of loyalty to his friend Chewbacca. He died helping others.<ref name="HttE" />

Throughout his life, Salporin made many connections and friendships to others, which he maintained until his untimely death in 9 ABY. His love for Gorrlyn kept him from leaving his homeworld and possibly seeking a better life,<ref name="HttES" /><ref name="G" /> and the two fought alongside each other during the Battle of Kashyyyk.<ref name="DB" /> Salporin and his friend Chewbacca each trusted each other endlessly, and their faith in the other's abilities meant they could work together with ease.<ref name="HttE" /><ref name="TT" /><ref name="HT" /> The two also spent much time testing each other physically, hoping to make each other tougher and stronger.<ref name="TT" /> Salporin was also very popular among the other Wookiees of his homeland, and was a close friend of Ralrracheen.<ref name="HttE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wookiee_charge_ROTSSB.jpg|thumb|right|Salporin and other Wookiees charge during the filming of ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
Salporin was created by ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Timothy Zahn]] for his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="HttE" /> Later, the official [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] Salporin to be one of the Wookiees seen fighting in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Portrayed by [[David Stiff]] in a Wookiee suit, his movements were used as a model for several digitally created Wookiees featured in the movie.<ref name="DB" />

The Salporin Wookiee costume is on display at the ''[[Star Wars: Where Science Meets Imagination]]'' exhibit.<ref name="At a Glance">{{WebCite|url=http://fwmuseum.org/starwars/Press_Releases/At_a_Glance.pdf|text=Star Wars: Where Science Meets Imagination At a Glance|date=2007-01-30|work=[[Wikipedia:Fort Worth Museum of Science and History|Fort Worth Museum of Science and History]]|archivedate=20070710095337}}</ref>
